verdict.rationale: Airweave is not itself an agent but a data-integration/search platform, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis; docs and a probe confirm a first-party MCP server implementing the Model Context Protocol so AI assistants/agents can search synced data, plus community confirmation it works well with Cursor. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability/performance beyond one community anecdote.
